headline: Discussion on artificial intelligence, updates to school policies, and the district's response to harassment, hazing and bullying of students.
summary: The agenda includes a review of the plan of work for 26-27, covering which policies to update or review and which old policies to sunset. It also includes a review of policy C10 on responding to harassment, hazing and bullying of students.
items: Review plan of work for 26-27: policies to update/review and old policies to sunset
Review C10 Response to Harassment, Hazing and Bullying of Students
location: Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street

BSD Policy & Governance Committee Meeting Agenda 
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street 
 
 
1. Opening   
1.1 Call meeting to order  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules  
2. Public Comment   
3. Discussion   
3.1 Artificial Intelligence (AI)  
3.2 Review plan of work for 26-27: policies to update/review and old policies to sunset  
3.3 Review C10 Response to Harassment, Hazing and Bullying of Students  
4. Adjournment  
Burlington School District Contact 864-8474 for questions on this agenda. This agenda is available in
